response.overview: A delusional psychopath sits in a police station, accused of the worst crime. Here is his confession: The kind and handsome Seth doesn’t worry himself when women in the street shrink away from him or men avoid his eyes. He knows their behaviour can be blamed on their weak minds and inferior nature.  Seth is content to live a solitary life, seperate from the clumsy population of New York… until he meets the perfect girl. Diane. She’s the diamond amongst the never ending rough, and she’s clearly in love with him.  Seth will stop at nothing to rescue Diane from her low-down waitress job and the hands of meddling man Michael. He will stop at nothing… even murder.
response.title: SIGNALS
